About TED
Our Organization
TED is a nonprofit that believes powerful ideas,
powerfully presented, move us: to feel something,
to think differently, to take action. In the past 40
years, TED's free platform has launched 225,000 +
talks in more than 100 languages, reaching billions
of people in every corner of the world. TED
activates its global audience by inspiring and
educating individuals and communities to imagine
and co-create a thriving future for all.
Our Mission:
Discover and champion the ideas
that shape our future
TED reached 180 million people and made 3 billion
digital impressions in 2023 alone. Our global
community welcomes people from every culture
and background who seek a deeper understanding
of the world and their role in it. We believe in the
power of ideas to change perspectives and spark
positive action, creating ripple effects of many
magnitudes across communities and ultimately,
humanity.
